inspectedText: The compiled Group1 record lists Barbados0–1PuertoRico, Grenada1–0PuertoRico after sudden death, and Barbados3–2Grenada after sudden death on27January. Its explicit note says sudden-death goals count double in goals-for/against columns. Final group totals are Barbados4–3, Grenada4–4, PuertoRico1–2, with three points each. This independently supports the weighted-margin arithmetic, not the minute-by-minute two-goal defending account. ChrisJ.McKain prepared the record with contributors; last update24July2003. This is a specialist historical compilation, not an official1994 match sheet. The raw number of scoring events and the weighted standings must be distinguished.
